scope: Corollary 3.6 (Affine germs at cleaned crossings) of the manuscript “Strong diffeomorphic approximation in three dimensions for 1≤p≤2” (preprints/Strong-diffeomorphic-approximation-in-three-dimensions-for-1-le-p-le-2-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 368 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 245e4bde0050d209), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 24. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let h be a homeomorphism between open three-manifolds. A crossing of a regular source surface with the preimage of a target line can be cleaned by applying Lemma 3.5 to the image surface. A crossing of a regular source curve with the preimage of a target surface can be cleaned by applying the Lemma to h−1. If the regular strata are straightened in C1 coordinates, the modified homeomorphism can additionally be made affine on a smaller neighborhood of every retained crossing. The only crossings there are the retained transverse ones. Supports can be prescribed to be small in both the source and target.
